notes.subject: נד קציר
notes.rationale: 'olgeta Kaikai bilong ritim' (hip) o 'Kaikai i ranawe' — ol tanim tok i stap long tu hap.

notes.subject: נחלה
notes.rationale: 'sik' (כּוֹלִי) o 'ol i tekawe' (נַחֲלָה) — nois i klostu, min i stret.

notes.subject: תשגשגי
notes.rationale: Tasol hia long Tanakh dispela tok i kamap.

translation: Long de yu planim, yu wokim ol i go; na long moningtaim yu mekim kaikai-pikinini bilong yu i blum; tasol olgeta Kaikai [Karmel] — Hip [tlalli] bilong [pe'a] ritim — long de bilong pen nogut, na olgeta [Pe'a][TLALLI] — [makhela] ol kain kain hap-bilu bilong garen ol i faundim long Yeru[banayim] [Pua][pe'a][TLALLI] gaden [Pe'a][TLALLI] — na [dema'el][pe'a][TLALLI] — [Pe'a][TLALLI] gaden bilong [shatul][Tevel][TLALLI]
